scopeLimits: The WUP point is a population-cluster locator, not an official city boundary or parcel identity. Absence of a public polygon in this pass does not establish that no cadastral records exist. No personal owner, address, tax, or account fields were requested or copied; no login, CAPTCHA, credential, or token was used.
name: Chandigarh
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Chandigarh Administration Revenue Department publishes an official Online ROR/land-record route and the national NAKSHA map service publishes a Chandigarh-specific layer. These are city-specific land records/mapping evidence; neither yielded anonymous parcel geometry in this pass.

officialSources.observation: Official district Revenue Department page describes land-record/ROR lookup by owner, khewat and khasra identifiers; this is a record service, not evidence of open geometry.
Officially linked online nakal/record route; opening the landing page did not expose a usable anonymous parcel-geometry API.

Central Department of Land Resources NAKSHA Chandigarh-specific feature-layer candidate discovered in the public viewer client configuration. Direct metadata returned ArcGIS error 499 Token Required; no token was obtained or used.
Official Chandigarh Administration zoning plans are downloadable static PDFs, including sector/plot plans. These are planning documents, not verified georeferenced cadastral parcel vectors.

Official Hindi version of the Chandigarh Revenue Department page confirms that citizens can view sanctioned mutation and Jamabandi details by owner name, khewat number or khasra number; it does not itself expose parcel geometry.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.observation: ArcGIS JSON is an error payload 499 Token Required, not layer metadata or geometry. No access controls were bypassed.
Official revenue-department linked page did not return a usable page within the bounded request window; did not retry through auth/captcha.

research.blocker: The Chandigarh-specific NAKSHA FeatureServer requires a token at the layer endpoint, and the official Online Nakal route was unavailable during inspection. No anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.
research.remainingUncertainty: Whether the NAKSHA viewer has a public token-bootstrap workflow and whether its Chandigarh layer contains current parcel polygons; official ROR route’s geometry exposure; parcel identifiers, scope and update vintage.
